description: A phasor whose rising ramp is bent into up to sixteen line segments, drawn on the display and moved by cable, for driving phase driven oscillators

params.text: Sets how many points the ramp is bent at, 3 to 16; adding points spreads them evenly again and loses the shape
Sets the pitch, -14 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 0.016Hz to 4186Hz
Scales the voltage at the FM jack, 0 to 300 per cent
While on, the FM jack is added to the frequency in hertz rather than to the pitch in octaves, which gives through-zero frequency modulation

inputs.text: Sets the height of that point, -5V to 5V, in place of where the point was dragged to
Sets where that point falls between the two points either side of it, 0-10V across the whole span between them
Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Modulates the frequency through the FM knob; with Lin off it is added to the pitch in octaves, and with Lin on it is added to the frequency itself, which lets it pass through zero
A trigger here puts the phase back to the start, which syncs it to another oscillator

notes: the points are dragged on the display with the left mouse button; the first and last points are held at the ends of the cycle, so only the inner ones can be moved sideways
randomising the module draws a fresh run of points, with a random length between 3 and 16
